request.prompt:
Goods: LED light bulb E27 9W 806lm, warm white
Country of origin: CN

Chosen so far: 85 Electrical machinery and equipment and parts thereof; sound recorders and reproducers; television image and sound recorders and reproducers, parts and accessories of such articles > 8539 Lamps; electric filament or discharge lamps, including sealed beam lamp units and ultra-violet or infra-red lamps, arc lamps, light-emitting diode (LED) light sources

Choose the subheading that covers these goods. Options:
- 853952: Lamps; light-emitting diode (LED) light sources, light-emitting diode (LED) lamps
- 853951: Lamps; light-emitting diode (LED) light sources, light-emitting diode (LED) modules
- 853922: Lamps; filament, (excluding ultra-violet or infra-red), of a power not exceeding 200W and for a voltage exceeding 100 volts, other than tungsten halogen

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: An E27 LED light bulb is a complete LED lamp, which falls under 8539.52 (LED lamps) rather than LED modules (8539.51) or filament lamps (8539.22).
